description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeReportingMethodDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests various methods related to employee reporting relationships, such as fetching supervisors and subordinates, counting them, and CRUD operations on reporting data.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeReportingMethodDao functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, including creating an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers_WhenReportToAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieving a reporting relationship when report-to data exists for given employee numbers.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportToByEmpNumbers_WhenReportToNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieving a reporting relationship when no data exists for given employee numbers.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount_WhenSubordinatesAvailable
methods.description: Tests counting subordinates when subordinates are present.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeSubordinatesCount_WhenSubordinatesNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests counting subordinates when none are present.

methods.name: testGetSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount_WhenSupervisorsAvailable
methods.description: Tests counting immediate supervisors when they are available.

methods.name: testGetSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisorsCount_WhenSupervisorsNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests counting immediate supervisors when none are available.

methods.name: testSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors_WhenSupervisorsNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests searching for immediate supervisors when none exist.

methods.name: testSearchImmediateEmployeeSupervisors_WhenSupervisorsAvailable
methods.description: Tests searching for immediate supervisors when they exist.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSubordinates_WhenSubordinatesAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieving subordinate records when they exist.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeSubordinates_WhenSubordinatesNotAvailable
methods.description: Tests retrieving subordinate records when none are found.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeReportTo_WithSupervisor
methods.description: Tests saving a reporting relationship with a supervisor.

methods.description: Tests saving a reporting relationship with a subordinate.
